summary: Iteration 3 (clients extended fields, NDIS-compliant invoices w/ dates + PATCH /sent, overdue dashboard alert, Credentials CRUD, Today's Notes upsert + rich style + photos) fully validated. Backend: 50/50 pytest tests pass (11 iter-1 + 21 iter-2 + 18 new iter-3). New tests cover: clients POST/GET/overview persist company/email/address/plan_manager; invoices POST/GET carry client_company/client_address/client_email/issue_date/due_date/sent_date, PATCH /api/invoices/{id}/sent sets sent_date to today (and 404 for unknown id); GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf still returns application/pdf w/ %PDF magic; GET /api/dashboard/stats returns overdue_count/overdue_amount and correctly excludes paid past-due and future-due-unpaid; Credentials CRUD (POST/GET sorted by expiry_date asc/PATCH/DELETE with 404); Today's Notes GET returns defaults (text='', font='system', font_size=16, text_color=#F0F9FF, bg_color=#0A1E24, photos=[]) and PUT+GET persists text/font/font_size/text_color/bg_color/photos array. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Dashboard renders Notes card (record-btn + fullscreen-btn + preview + inline input) and Tools row includes 'Certs & Insurance' → /credentials. Overdue alert 'X overdue invoice · $Y — follow up' appears when overdue invoice exists and taps through to /invoices. /credentials screen: type chips (Certificate/Insurance/License), title/issuer/expiry inputs, camera+gallery photo buttons, save-credential-btn all render; UI end-to-end save of TEST_UI_PL Insurance verified in list. /notes editor: notes-input, mic-btn, add-photo-camera/lib, font-inc/dec, font-system/serif/mono, 6 text-color + 6 bg-color swatches, save-notes-btn all present and functional; save round-trips to backend. Add-client modal shows all new fields (name/company/ndis/email/phone/address/plan-manager) and saves. Client detail shows billing/paid/pending summary and 'Invoices' section renders new invoice with correct pre-fill. Invoice builder has Company/Billing Address/Billing Email/Issue Date/Due Date fields. Invoice detail shows 'Issued', 'Sent: —', 'Due:', Mark paid, Send PDF. Voice/photo capture and PDF share are DEVICE-ONLY (Whisper transcribe API + credential base64 image save independently verified via backend tests). Local push reminders for invoice due dates are DEVICE-ONLY (expo-notifications on web). Bug fix applied: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/clients.tsx was missing `ScrollView` import causing 'ReferenceError: ScrollView is not defined' when the add-client modal rendered — fix added to imports and expo restarted; re-tested with zero console errors.

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary dict body without Pydantic partial-update model (id/_id popped only). Consider CredentialUpdate model.
Invalid non-24-hex id still returns 500 (uncaught bson.errors.InvalidId). Wrap ObjectId() in try/except and raise 400. (Carried over from iter 2, not blocking.)

overdue detection uses string date compare (due_date < today[:10]). Works because both are ISO YYYY-MM-DD but breaks if due_date is stored in a different format (e.g. ISO with time). Currently safe because invoices only store YYYY-MM-DD.
date path param is not validated as YYYY-MM-DD — any string becomes a mongo _id. Consider a simple regex validator.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `ScrollView` import while used inside add-client modal caused 'ReferenceError: ScrollView is not defined' and broke the entire Clients screen on tab focus. FIXED by testing agent (added ScrollView to the react-native import list).

issues: Persistent (harmless) console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)'. Carried over from iterations 1 & 2.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Wrap ObjectId(id) parsing in try/except across GET/PATCH/DELETE endpoints and raise 400 for malformed ids instead of 500 (still open from iter 2).
(Optional cleanup) Add Pydantic partial-update models for PATCH /credentials/{id}, PATCH /clients/{id}, PATCH /reminders/{id}, PATCH /tasks/{id}.
(Optional) Add YYYY-MM-DD path validator on GET/PUT /api/notes/{date} to prevent arbitrary string _id keys.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Invoice model correctly adds client_company/client_address/client_email/issue_date/due_date/sent_date with defaults so PDF & existing GETs stay backward compatible.
PATCH /api/invoices/{id}/sent correctly sets sent_date to today (UTC, ISO date-only) and returns full updated doc (404 on unknown id).
dashboard_stats overdue detection filters unpaid AND due_date < today — paid or future-due excluded. Verified end-to-end.
Credential model uses expiry_date sort ascending — earliest expiry first (good UX for renewal prompts).
DailyNote uses date string as _id (upsert-friendly) and DEFAULT_NOTE is spread AFTER stored doc in GET, so we correctly fall back to defaults for missing fields. Good.
clients.tsx missed importing ScrollView — HIGH severity because it hard-crashed the Clients tab. Fixed.

rca_of_issue: Clients tab crash: Files imported React Native primitives on line 2-4 but omitted ScrollView while adding a ScrollView wrapper inside the add-client modal in iter-3. Metro bundler does not fail (JSX only fails at render), so the tab loaded but a ReferenceError was thrown on modal render, unmounting the whole Clients component and leaving the screen stuck in the loading state. Fix: added ScrollView to the react-native named import list. Verified by reopening the modal and successfully filling all new-client-* testIDs. No other files had the same pattern (grepped for `<ScrollView` without matching import elsewhere).
